svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 04 · Irvine · 11/12 The Open Hills (Common)
svg.desc: Golden hills kept open at the edge of town. Early on, the marine layer fills the flats below you. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
